newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish banks move to prevent money laundering.
newsitem.headline: Turkish banks move to prevent money laundering.

text.p: Turkish banks will ask their customers to declare their personal identification details in a move to prevent money laundering, according to a new regulation published in the Official Gazette on Wednesday.

The regulation said bank customers would have to disclose their identification details when they rent bank safes, and deposit, transfer or withdraw more than one billion lira from their accounts or cash in cheques.
The banks will keep identification records for five years.
The threshold of one billion lira will be revised every year in line with wholesale price inflation.
